units.title: Owned descriptor from a borrowed handle
units.scope: Duplicate a real file descriptor while preserving the borrowed handle and shared offset.
units.remaining_evidence: Exec inheritance, descriptor census and failed-redirection rollback remain.
steps: Define borrowed and owned descriptor roles
implement hs_dup_owned with atomic close-on-exec duplication
close the owned descriptor and observe the original offset

references.locator: fcntl(2) — F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC; dup(2) — shared open file description and offsets
references.purpose: Duplicate a real file descriptor while preserving the borrowed handle and shared offset.

claims.scope: Duplicate a real file descriptor while preserving the borrowed handle and shared offset.

artifact_contracts.limitations: Exec inheritance, descriptor census and failed-redirection rollback remain.

units.title: Bounded partial file transfer
units.scope: Copy an actual fragmented pipe stream to a real file with a caller-set byte ceiling.
units.remaining_evidence: Forced EINTR/short output scheduling, pathname races, positioned offsets and durability remain.
steps: Implement hs_copy using bounded storage
track bytes actually written when failure interrupts a chunk
reuse the transfer contract on EOF and /dev/full
checks: bad input and ENOSPC preserve accepted count

references.locator: read(2) and write(2) — short transfers, EINTR, EOF and error return contracts
references.purpose: Copy an actual fragmented pipe stream to a real file with a caller-set byte ceiling.

claims.scope: Copy an actual fragmented pipe stream to a real file with a caller-set byte ceiling.

artifact_contracts.limitations: Forced EINTR/short output scheduling, pathname races, positioned offsets and durability remain.

units.title: Monotonic deadline and cancellation
units.scope: Poll real input/cancellation descriptors against an absolute monotonic deadline.
units.remaining_evidence: timerfd/eventfd accumulation, rescheduling, callback execution latency and independent races remain.
steps: State the single-reader ownership rule
implement hs_read_until with cancellation winning simultaneous readiness
recompute remaining duration after interruptions
checks: cancel leaves simultaneously ready data untouched

references.locator: poll(2) — readiness, return values and EINTR; clock_gettime(2) — CLOCK_MONOTONIC
references.purpose: Poll real input/cancellation descriptors against an absolute monotonic deadline.

claims.scope: Poll real input/cancellation descriptors against an absolute monotonic deadline.

artifact_contracts.limitations: timerfd/eventfd accumulation, rescheduling, callback execution latency and independent races remain.

units.title: Child exit and complete reap
units.scope: Create and reap real child processes, retaining full parent-side ownership of their status.
units.remaining_evidence: exec error channels, multithreaded fork restrictions, abnormal termination and pipeline cleanup remain.
steps: Implement hs_spawn_exit
distinguish raw wait status from decoded exit code
verify that no child remains waitable after success
checks: leave output unchanged on rejected input

references.locator: fork(2) — descriptor inheritance; waitpid(2) — WIFEXITED and WEXITSTATUS; _exit(2) — status
references.purpose: Create and reap real child processes, retaining full parent-side ownership of their status.

claims.scope: Create and reap real child processes, retaining full parent-side ownership of their status.

units.title: Shared mapping with offset records
units.scope: A real child publishes a record into MAP_SHARED storage using fixed-width offsets.
units.remaining_evidence: Cross-endian format, unrelated process attachment, resizing, concurrent publication and crash ownership remain.
steps: Validate offset plus length without overflow
write fixed-width metadata and payload in the child
use successful wait as completion before the parent reads

keep output length unchanged on a rejected frame
declare close-on-protocol-error as the caller policy

units.title: Masked signal handoff
units.scope: Generate and synchronously consume real SIGUSR1/SIGUSR2 while restoring the original mask.
units.remaining_evidence: Thread-wide mask coordination, handler safety and self-pipe/signalfd tradeoff defense remain.
steps: State exclusive ownership of the chosen signal and absence of a preexisting pending instance
block before generating and waiting
restore the mask only after consuming the notification
